name: Dearest Elenia,
label: Quest
description: Dearest Elenia,: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?
But after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.
When I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh, and to what do I owe this pleasure?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You wouldn't expect an orc to be so eloquent. Of course, we never really had a chance to know them before now. Thank you for bringing this to me.
